result.summary: The interface is well-structured but has minor styling and content-related inconsistencies.

issues.description: Text labels for delivery fees and certain promo badges have low color contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text colors and more vibrant badge backgrounds to improve legibility.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used as placeholders for food items, which looks stylistically inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Replace illustrations with high-quality restaurant photography for a more professional appearance.
